name: get_current_weather
description: Get current weather conditions (temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind) for a location given its latitude and longitude.

inputSchema.description: Coordinates of the location to fetch current weather for.

outputSchema.description: Current weather conditions for the requested location, or an error if the upstream call failed.

timezone.description: IANA timezone resolved for the coordinates

observation_time.description: ISO 8601 local timestamp of the observation

wind_speed_mph.description: Wind speed in miles per hour

error.description: Present instead of the fields above if the call failed
